translations.b0003: Part 1  Striving to Open Up New Prospects for Chinese Modernization
translations.b0004: In the process of basically realizing socialist modernization, the 15th Five-Year Plan period plays an important role in building on past achievements and opening up the future and is a crucial period for consolidating the foundations and making an all-out effort. Unremitting and sustained efforts must be made to secure major breakthroughs in the strategic tasks that bear on the overall cause of Chinese modernization and to lay a still more solid foundation for basically realizing socialist modernization.
translations.b0006: Standing at a new starting point, China has a still more solid foundation for development, while its development environment has undergone profound and complex changes, presenting new opportunities and challenges.
translations.b0007: Section 1  Major Achievements in China’s Development During the 14th Five-Year Plan Period
translations.b0008: The 14th Five-Year Plan period was the opening and initial stage of the new journey to build a modern socialist country in all respects, and China’s development during this period was truly extraordinary and remarkable. In the face of a complex and fluid international situation and the formidable and arduous tasks of advancing domestic reform, development and stability, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core united and led the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups in China in rising to the challenges and pressing forward with determination. They withstood the severe shock of the once-in-a-century pandemic, effectively responded to a series of major risks and challenges, and drove new and major achievements in the cause of the Party and the country.
translations.b0009: The guiding role of the new development philosophy has been fully demonstrated, important steps have been taken in building a new development paradigm, new quality productive forces have developed steadily, and high-quality development has been solidly advanced. The economy has maintained steady growth with progress: GDP has exceeded 140 trillion yuan; major progress has been made in building a modern industrial system; infrastructure support capacity has continued to improve; the added value of the core industries of the digital economy has accounted for more than 10.5%; and urban-rural and regional development has become more balanced and coordinated. Fruitful results have been achieved in scientific and technological innovation: R&D spending as a share of GDP has reached 2.8%; a number of major core technologies in key fields have been mastered; and a number of major original scientific and technological achievements have been made. Reform across the board has been further advanced; the institutions and mechanisms for implementing the “two unswervings” have been steadily improved; positive results have been achieved in building a unified national market; and the effectiveness of macroeconomic governance has been further enhanced. High-standard opening up has continued to expand; a new system for an open economy has taken shape at a faster pace; and high-quality “Belt and Road” cooperation has become deeper and more substantive. Whole-process people’s democracy has developed in depth, and law-based governance in all respects has been effectively implemented. Cultural programs and cultural industries have flourished, and intellectual and cultural products have become rich and varied. Public wellbeing has been secured on a solid basis: per capita disposable income of residents has grown by 5.4% annually on average; new urban jobs have reached a cumulative total of 62.42 million; the average years of schooling for the working-age population has reached 11.3; average life expectancy has risen to over 79 years; and the outcomes of poverty alleviation have been consolidated and expanded. The green and low-carbon transition has accelerated, and the quality of the ecological environment has continued to improve: installed non-fossil energy power generation capacity has surpassed fossil energy capacity; the concentration of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in cities at the prefecture level and above has fallen to 28 µg/m³; the proportion of surface water at or better than Grade III has exceeded 90%; and forest coverage has exceeded 25%. China’s national security capacity has been effectively enhanced; grain output has reached a new high of 1.4 trillion jin; social governance has become more effective; and the overall social situation has remained stable. Major progress has been made in national defense and military development. The practice of “One Country, Two Systems” has been advanced in depth. Major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics has been comprehensively expanded. Full and rigorous Party self-governance has produced marked results, the fight against corruption has been advanced in depth, and the Party’s creativity, cohesion and fighting capacity have noticeably increased.
translations.b0010: The main objectives and tasks of the 14th Five-Year Plan have been successfully completed; China’s economic strength, scientific and technological strength, national defense strength and composite national strength have reached a new level; Chinese modernization has taken new and solid steps forward; and the new journey toward the Second Centenary Goal has gotten off to a good start. These major achievements are fundamentally attributable to the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core charting the course and steering the ship, and to the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; they are the result of the whole Party, the entire military and the people of all ethnic groups in China pooling their strength to tackle hard problems and working together in unity.
translations.b0011: Section 2  Profound and Complex Changes Facing China’s Development Environment During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
translations.b0012: Relations among major countries affect the international situation, and the evolution of the international situation profoundly impacts domestic development. China’s development is in a period in which strategic opportunities coexist with risks and challenges and uncertain and unpredictable factors are increasing. Internationally, the once-in-a-century changes in the world are evolving at an accelerated pace, the international balance of power is undergoing profound adjustment, and a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation is making accelerated breakthroughs; China has many favorable factors for proactively managing its international space and shaping its external environment. At the same time, the world is experiencing intertwined changes and turmoil and intensifying instability; geopolitical conflicts occur frequently and repeatedly; the global governance deficit is growing and security issues have become prominent; unilateralism and protectionism are on the rise and the threat of hegemonism and power politics has increased; the international economic and trade order faces severe challenges, and the momentum for world economic growth is insufficient with risks accumulating; and major-country competition is becoming more complex and intense, significantly increasing the uncertainty and instability of the external environment.
translations.b0013: Domestically, China’s economy has a stable foundation, many advantages, strong resilience and great potential; the supporting conditions and fundamental trend for long-term sound development have not changed; and the advantages of the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, of a super-large-scale market, of a complete industrial system and of abundant human resources have become more pronounced. At the same time, the problem of unbalanced and inadequate development remains prominent, and cyclical, structural and institutional problems are intertwined; effective demand is insufficient, the contradiction of strong supply and weak demand is acute, and there are bottlenecks and blockages in domestic circulation; the task of replacing old growth drivers with new ones is arduous; agricultural and rural modernization lags relatively behind; employment and household income growth face considerable pressure, and there are weak links in public wellbeing; demographic changes pose new issues for economic development and social governance; and risks and hidden dangers remain in key areas, with the onerous task of preventing and resolving risks in real estate, local government debt, small and medium-sized financial institutions and other areas.
translations.b0014: Changes bring opportunities, and challenges inspire resolve. In the face of a shifting international landscape and various risks and challenges, it is essential to deeply understand the decisive significance of the “two establishments”; enhance the “Four Consciousnesses” and firm up the “Four Confidences”; ensure the “Two Upholds”; maintain strategic resolve and strengthen confidence in victory; proactively identify, respond to and seek change; be courageous and adept in struggle; be bold enough to face major tests of high winds and rough seas and even perilous storms; overcome difficulties, counter risks and meet challenges with a spirit of historical initiative; concentrate efforts on managing China’s own affairs well; and take a coordinated approach with careful arrangements to consolidate and expand strengths, break through bottlenecks and constraints, and shore up weaknesses, so as to win strategic initiative in fierce international competition, respond to all kinds of uncertainty with the certainty of high-quality development, and write a new chapter in the two miracles of rapid economic development and long-term social stability.
translations.b0016: To advance economic and social development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, it is imperative to firmly grasp the following guiding thought and major principles.
translations.b0018: China will uphold Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the Theory of Three Represents, and the Scientific Outlook on Development; fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 20th CPC National Congress and the successive plenary sessions of the 20th CPC Central Committee; and earnestly implement the arrangements of the Fourth Plenary Session. Centering on building a great modern socialist country in all respects, realizing the Second Centenary Goal, and advancing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese modernization, China will pursue coordinated progress in the “five-sphere integrated plan” and the “four-pronged comprehensive strategy,” take into account both the domestic and international situations, fully, accurately and comprehensively implement the new development philosophy, accelerate the building of a new development paradigm, adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, take economic development as the central task, take high-quality development as the theme, take reform and innovation as the fundamental driving force, take meeting the people’s ever-growing needs for a better life as the fundamental purpose, and take full and rigorous Party self-governance as the fundamental guarantee. It will work to achieve effective qualitative improvement and reasonable quantitative growth of the economy, make solid progress in promoting well-rounded human development and common prosperity for all the people, and ensure decisive progress in basically realizing socialist modernization.
translations.b0019: Section 2  Principles That Must Be Followed
translations.b0020: Upholding the Party’s overall leadership. It is necessary to resolutely uphold the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee; enhance the Party’s ability to set the direction, devise the overall strategy, formulate policies and promote reform; embed Party leadership in all aspects and the entire process of economic and social development; and provide a fundamental guarantee for China’s socialist modernization.
translations.b0021: Putting the people first. It is necessary to respect the principal position of the people, closely rely on the people, safeguard the people’s fundamental interests and promote social fairness and justice; focus on ensuring and improving public wellbeing through development and on expanding development space in the course of meeting the people’s livelihood needs; promote coordinated economic and social development and ensure that material and cultural-ethical advancement reinforce each other; and ensure that the fruits of modernization benefit all the people more fully and fairly.
translations.b0022: Pursuing high-quality development. It is necessary to guide development with the new development philosophy, develop new quality productive forces in light of local conditions, strengthen domestic circulation, smooth domestic and international dual circulation, take coordinated steps to expand domestic demand and deepen supply-side structural reform, accelerate the cultivation of new growth drivers, promote the optimization and upgrading of the economic structure, improve the quality of incremental growth and revitalize existing stock, and drive sustained and sound economic development and all-round social progress.
translations.b0023: Deepening reform across the board. It is necessary to focus on the institutional obstacles that constrain high-quality development, advance deeper-level reform, expand high-standard opening up, promote better alignment between the relations of production and the productive forces, between the superstructure and the economic base, and between national governance and social development, and continuously enhance the momentum for development and the vitality of society.
translations.b0024: Combining an effective market with a well-functioning government. It is necessary to give full play to the decisive role of the market in resource allocation and better play the role of the government, build a unified, open, competitive and orderly market system, develop a law-based and credit-based economy, create a world-class business environment that is market-oriented, law-based and internationalized, and foster an economic order that is both “dynamic” and “well-regulated.”
translations.b0025: Pursuing development and security in a coordinated way. It is necessary to consolidate security through development and pursue development through security, strengthen worst-case thinking, effectively prevent and resolve all types of risks, enhance economic and social resilience, and safeguard a new development paradigm with a new security architecture.
translations.b0027: The following objectives shall be achieved in economic and social development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
translations.b0028: Notable results will be achieved in high-quality development. On the basis of structural optimization and quality improvement, GDP growth will be kept within a reasonable range, with annual targets proposed as appropriate, so as to lay a solid foundation for doubling per capita GDP by 2035 compared with 2020 and reaching the level of a moderately developed country. Total factor productivity will rise steadily, and scientific and technological progress and institutional innovation will contribute an ever-greater share to economic growth. The household consumption rate will rise markedly; domestic demand will play an even stronger primary role in driving economic growth; and the potential of economic growth will be fully unleashed. The building of a unified national market will be advanced in depth, and the advantages of a super-large-scale market will continue to emerge. Major progress will be made in new industrialization, informatization, urbanization and agricultural modernization; the modern industrial system will become more complete, advanced and secure at a faster pace; urban-rural and regional development will become more coordinated; and major breakthroughs will be made in developing new quality productive forces, building a new development paradigm and establishing a modernized economic system.
translations.b0029: The level of self-reliance and self-strengthening in science and technology will rise substantially. The overall performance of the national innovation system will improve markedly; R&D spending will grow by more than 7% annually on average; and a pattern of integrated development of education, science and technology, and human resources will basically take shape. Basic research and original innovation capacity will be significantly strengthened; rapid breakthroughs will be made in core technologies in key fields; a number of major original, landmark and leading scientific and technological achievements will be produced; and the number of fields in which China is running abreast of or leading the world will increase noticeably. Scientific and technological innovation will be deeply integrated with industrial innovation, and the role of innovation-driven development will be markedly strengthened.
translations.b0030: New breakthroughs will be made in further deepening reform across the board. Modernization of China’s governance system and capacity will be advanced in depth; the socialist market economy will be further improved; the institutions and mechanisms for high-standard opening up will be further refined; a fairer and more dynamic market environment will take shape at a faster pace; whole-process people’s democracy will become more institutionalized, standardized and procedural; and the building of a socialist rule of law country will reach a higher level.
translations.b0031: The level of social civilization will rise markedly. Cultural confidence will be firmer; the mainstream ideology and public opinion will be continuously consolidated and strengthened; the core socialist values will be widely practiced; the cultural innovation and creativity of the whole nation will be constantly stimulated; the people’s intellectual and cultural lives will be richer; the cohesion of the Chinese nation and the influence of Chinese culture will be significantly enhanced; and the country’s soft power will continue to increase.
translations.b0032: The quality of people’s lives will improve steadily. Employment will remain generally stable, with the surveyed urban unemployment rate below 5.5%, and new progress will be made toward high-quality full employment. Personal income growth will keep pace with economic growth, and increases in labor remuneration will keep pace with increases in labor productivity; the distribution structure will be improved; and the middle-income group will continue to expand. The average years of schooling for the working-age population will rise to 11.7; the people’s needs for elderly care and childcare services will be better met; average life expectancy will rise to 80 years; the social security system will be better optimized and more sustainable; and equal access to basic public services will improve markedly.
translations.b0033: New and major progress will be made in building a Beautiful China. Green production and lifestyles will basically take shape; the carbon peaking target will be met on schedule; CO2 emissions per unit of GDP will be reduced by 17%; and a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient new energy system will be preliminarily established. The quality of the ecological environment will improve across the board; total emissions of major pollutants will continue to decrease; the concentration of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in cities at the prefecture level and above will fall to below 27 µg/m³; the proportion of water bodies with good-quality water will rise to 85%; forest coverage will reach 25.8%; and the diversity, stability and sustainability of ecosystems will continue to improve.
translations.b0034: The national security shield will be further consolidated. The national security system and capacity will be further strengthened; comprehensive grain production capacity will reach around 1.45 trillion jin; comprehensive energy production capacity will reach 5.8 billion tonnes of standard coal; risks in key areas will be effectively prevented and resolved; social governance and public security governance will improve markedly; major and especially serious accidents will be effectively curbed; the capacity to prevent natural disasters will be significantly enhanced; the centenary goal of the People’s Liberation Army will be achieved on schedule; and the building of a Peaceful China at a higher level will be solidly advanced.
translations.b0035: Building on this foundation, China will strive for another five years so that by 2035 its economic strength, scientific and technological strength, national defense strength, composite national strength and international influence will have risen substantially, per capita GDP will have reached the level of a moderately developed country, people’s lives will be happier and better, and socialist modernization will have been basically realized.
